settings.credential: Live-looping soloist · teaches Master the Handpan
settings.relation: Originally a classical flute player, jazz drummer and music producer, who became a bold handpan explorer, bringing the instrument to high intensity world music rhythms, classical sonatas and live looping masterpieces.
settings.quote: What resonates with me in Ayasa craft is the constant search for pristine sound and balance. Elements that are essential in my own music. Every scale that I try brings me new inspiration and new perspectives
settings.relation_more:
His musician career spans over 3 decades, as a live drummer, a soundtrack composer and producer for documentaries, exhibitions, as well as radio anthems.

His 10 years as an international one man band artist have contributed to bringing the handpan to a new realm, numerous crowds discovering that this instrument can be an ambient and electro instrument, without any computer involved.

He is also a celebrated teacher on the Masterthehandpan portal, as well as in festivals and handpan retreats around the world.
